title: Spencer Stuart’s Citrin on Apple’s CEO Succession Plan
description: Jim Citrin, Chair, Global CEO Practice at Spencer Stuart, discusses the upcoming CEO transition at Apple as Tim Cook prepares to step down on September 1, with John Turner set to take over. Citrin emphasizes the critical importance and difficulty of CEO succession, especially at a company like Apple known for its excellence. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: IDC’s Popal on Apple’s Earnings, Smartphone Competitors
description: Nabila Popal, Senior Director of Data & Analytics at IDC, discusses the current state of the global smartphone market, highlighting a 7% decline in shipments in the second quarter due to extended upgrade cycles and a memory crisis impacting supply chains. Despite these headwinds, Apple has demonstrated remarkable resilience, achieving double-digit year-on-year shipment growth of 15% and strong iPhone revenue performance. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Amazon Gains After Fifth Straight Quarter of Cloud Sales Growth
description: Amazon.com Inc. shares jumped after the company reported cloud-computing revenue accelerated for a fifth straight quarter, easing investors’ concerns that it won’t produce a return on huge expenditures to meet the booming demand for artificial intelligence.
